name: veilai-buildhybridai
description: VeilAI — Zero-Leak Split-Brain Hybrid AI Workspace built with Firebase AI Logic

scripts.build: npm run build:core && npm run build:web && npm run build:extension
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=@veilai/hybrid-core && npm run typecheck --workspace=@veilai/web && npm run typecheck --workspace=@veilai/extension
scripts.deploy:hosting: npm run build:web && npx -y firebase-tools@latest deploy --only hosting
